conversion_note: REGENERATED 11 Aug 2026 on the #779/#784 onset anchors (PR #784): charge resolves from roast_runs.t0_detected_at_utc and first crack from raw_state_json.first_crack_status.detected_at_utc, each mapped onto the run-relative clock by the nearest telemetry row. The previous figures were CONFIRMATION-anchored and understated development. Correction directions were DERIVED PER ROAST, never assumed, and they genuinely differ: 3fbfd888 +0.7 pp, d251013e +1.8 pp, 5a32334c -0.1 pp. Cross-checked from first principles against the store's own event timestamps - DTR via onset computes 11.57 / 12.60 / 13.01 %, which the exporter reproduces to within ~0.1 pp. PROVENANCE: the frozen telemetry development_percent is VERSION-STAMPED at #337 (the FC/T0 backdating consumer, closed 23 Jun 2026), so this corpus holds TWO definitions of DTR. 3fbfd888 ran 21 Jun, BEFORE it: its frozen 10.84 is a faithful record of the receive-time anchor the controller used then - a version artefact, not a defect. 5a32334c (27 Jun, post-#337) agrees to 0.02 pp (frozen 12.58 vs onset 12.60); there is no disagreement on that run. Only d251013e is genuinely anomalous: post-#337 and MCP-sourced, its frozen 14.09 EXCEEDS the onset-derived 13.01 by 1.08 pp, the wrong direction for any anchoring explanation. That single outlier is the open #792 question. Earlier note retained: store_to_fixture.py tolerates schema v6 stores (PR #224); the drop event correctly reads the phase_changed->cooling transition, not run_completed.
